Name: Stardew Kids Expansion - SVE NPC Festival Location Fix
Author: aerinanxiety
Description:
[center]﻿
[u][b]What is it?
[/b][/u]
I have a little bit of a perfectionist streak in me, and when I see NPCs overlapping I [b]HAVE[/b] to fix them if the mod author is too busy, etc.

This mod specifically changes Egg Y1 Festival positioning of Tina from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7940]Stardew Kids Expanded[/url] to no longer overlap with the bench with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]. It also changes the positioning of Adrian and Tina during the Y1 Flower Dance so they're no longer in a tree and in a bunch of flowers, respectively.[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7940]

[/url]﻿[b][u]Installation
[/u][/b]Unzip the .rar file and drag its contents into your mods folder. Allow it to overwrite. Thats it!

[b][u]Have a request?
[/u][/b]If you find any schedule overlaps or festival overlaps in any NPC mods, please let me know!
If the creator of the mods has no intention of fixing the issue (most have bigger things to work on!) and I obtain permission, I'll do my best do push out a patch.[/center]
